## Axis Targets

| Axis | Target | Higher Is Better |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LoCoMo | score >= 0.80 | yes |
| MemoryAgentBench | score >= 0.80 | yes |
| MemoryArena | score >= 0.60 | yes |
| MLMF retention | retention >= published baseline | yes |
| ToM Sally-Anne | accuracy >= 0.80 | yes |
| HTN planning | depth-3 goal achievement >= 0.85 | yes |
| Real-time latency | normalized score >= 1.00 | yes |

## Submission Validation

Validate a candidate submission before opening a pull request:

```bash
python scripts/validate_submission.py bench/submissions/<your-framework>.yaml
```
